notes: Published pedestrian counts of famous busy crossings, used for the crowd per signal cycle when a crossing of a map lies within r m of one (scramble.py); everywhere else the crowd comes from CROWD's pedestrians per minute of the place and the places around the crossing. per_cycle: people crossing in one green; cycle_s, walk_s: the signal cycle and the pedestrian green as reported.

crossings.name: Shibuya scramble crossing
crossings.source: Wikipedia, Shibuya Crossing (1,000-2,000 people per green, up to 3,000 per green light every 2 minutes; 2014 survey: 260,000 a weekday, 390,000 on non-working days); LIVE JAPAN, Shibuya Scramble Crossing (the green averages about 40-50 s)
